    qubo = {(f"x{i}", f"x{j}"): 1 if i != j else 0 for i, j in zip(range(data["num_variables"]), range(1, data["num_variables"]+1))}

    # Define the equality constraint
    qubo[(f"x1", f"x2")] += data["constraints"][0]["expression"] - 2
    qubo[(f"x3", f"x4")] += data["constraints"][0]["expression"] - 2

    # Define the mutual exclusion constraints
    qubo[(f"x1", f"x2")] += -2 * data["constraints"][1]["expression"]
    qubo[(f"x3", f"x4")] += -2 * data["constraints"][2]["expression"]

    # Define the objective function to maximize total urgency
    objective = sum(variables.values())
    qubo[-k:] = {-k: obj for k, obj in enumerate([-objective])}
